design_notes: single-blinded, placebo-controlled, randomized crossover design; two testing days separated by a minimum of 1 week washout; order of intervention counterbalanced

population.condition: the disease or condition defining the trial population, without qualifiers such as glycaemic control, ethnicity or care setting. If participants are not selected for a disease (e.g. healthy volunteers), use the article’s own short description of the population.
key_inclusion_criteria: healthy volunteers with a large variance in body weight
no history of neurological, psychiatric, gastrointestinal or eating disorders
